title: Roadmap
lead: What comes next, and what we have in mind after that. There are no dates, and plans can change.

cameraEffects.title: Background blur and backgrounds
cameraEffects.text: Blur your room on camera or put a picture behind you, worked out on your own device.

streamerMode.title: Streamer mode
streamerMode.text: Hides addresses, invites and other private details while you stream, and turns on by itself when the desktop app sees your streaming program.

profileDecor.title: Profile decorations
profileDecor.text: Frames for your picture, effects for your profile and nameplates, free for everyone.

themeStudio.title: Theme studio
themeStudio.text: Make your own look, share it with a link, or offer one to your space.

history.title: Edit history
history.text: See what a message said before it was edited, if you wrote it or look after the channel.

scheduled.title: Scheduled messages
scheduled.text: Write something now and have it sent later.

notes.title: Private notes on people
notes.text: A note on someone's profile that only you can see.

altText.title: Descriptions for pictures
altText.text: Describe a picture for people who cannot see it.

ageRestricted.title: Age-restricted channels
ageRestricted.text: A channel you enter after saying you are old enough, with nothing of it in search or notifications.

accounts.title: Several accounts on one device
accounts.text: Switch between up to five accounts without signing out.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, your face or a security key instead of a password.

publicExplore.title: Explore without an account
publicExplore.text: See what spaces there are before you sign up.

spacePages.title: A page for each public space
spacePages.text: An address to share that shows what a space is about, with a way to join.

statistics.title: Statistics for space owners
statistics.text: How many people join, leave and write, as numbers that name nobody.

later.title: Later
later.note: What we would like to do. Nothing here is promised yet.

signIn.title: Sign in with Tavvit
signIn.text: Use your account to sign in to other websites and apps.

botButtons.title: Buttons and menus in messages
botButtons.text: Bots can offer choices to click on instead of commands to type.

signedApp.title: A signed desktop app
signedApp.text: No more warning from Windows when you install the app.

watchDm.title: Watching together in direct calls
watchDm.text: Watch together in calls with friends too, not only in a space's voice channel.
